907-2174-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-2174-2645-3430.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

240-4068-5470-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-4068-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

141-728-7446.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonland permanent card in your graveyard.
141-728-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2034-2415-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-4716.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1671-6798-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

465-670-1619-6137.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6137.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Barrowin of Clan Undurr.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Barrowin of Clan Undurr from exile to the battlefield.
When Barrowin of Clan Undurr enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Barrowin of Clan Undurr trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Barrowin of Clan Undurr.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

338-5789-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-5789-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3644-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3644-6797-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1017-4893-7426-7628.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1017-4893-7426-7628.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-4478-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2806-6596.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Hermes
1618-2440-2806-6596.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Hermes triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2806-6596.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Hermes. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

4824-5963-7308.description:
Activate Marvin using Mona Lisa's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to Marvin's power.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

57-4460-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4460-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

321-399-489-2475-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6965-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-4488-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

149-2757-5016--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-2757-5016--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

2366-5231-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5231-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3129-3899-4241-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2292-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-6723-6968-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6723-6968-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

5175-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing land who can produce mana of the color named by Caged Sun.
5175-6871.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least one mana of the color named by Caged Sun.
Caged Sun triggers, adding one mana of that color.
Caged Sun triggers again, as it is a land due to Toph, adding one mana of that color.
Step 3 repeats in a mandatory infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

1115-1563-2457-4321.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1879-2457-3000-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2034-3490-6283-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-6283-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Haliya indestructible.
2034-3490-6283-6752.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-3499-4289-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2530-2577-6097-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-6097-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1741-4893-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1741-4893-5900.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

1987-3277-4276-4863.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3277-4276-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Izzet Chronarch.
When Revolutionist and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-4276-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2060-2313-2713-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2313-2713-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

710-2034-2961.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

1636-1648-3143-4642.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-1648-3143-4642.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Nissa of Shadowed Boughs trigger.
Resolve the Nissa of Shadowed Boughs trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

240-526-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
240-526-3967.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

1724-4304-5929.description:
Cast Sekki by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Sekki enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Leyline of Transformation.
Ayula triggers, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control.
Sekki removes a number of +1/+1 counters from it equal to the damage it would've been dealt and creates that many 1/1 Spirit creature tokens, which are Bears due to Leyline of Transformation.
When the Spirit Bear(s) enter the battlefield, Ayula triggers that many times.
If Sekki is on the battlefield, resolve an Ayula trigger, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control, and then repeat from step 3.
If Sekki is not on the battlefield, activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Bear with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Leyline of Transformation.
If Sekki entered the battlefield, Ayula triggers, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 3.
1724-4304-5929.notes: You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control.

1799-2556-2579-2701-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, adding one mana of any color.
When Mnemonic Wall dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Mnemonic Wall from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Mnemonic Wall from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

633-4013-4659.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control have at least two abilities listed by Odric.
633-4013-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Odric.
Odric enters the battlefield, creating at least two Blood tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Blood tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1161-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Drana's Chosen does not have summoning sickness.
An additional ally on the battlefield.
1161-1636.description:
Tap Drana's Chosen and your additional ally to create a tapped 2/2 zombie token.
When the token ETBs, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat for infinite tokens.
